tools.name: set_wallet_allowlist
tools.description: Store the 0x wallets this sg_live_ key is allowed to spend from. Call it when an operator names those wallets, once, not on every spend, and not to approve a payment. score_spend still has to run before any transfer. A block or ask_human from score_spend means do not broadcast. Pass allowed_wallets.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: score_spend · Private data: score_spend, get_api_key, set_wallet_allowlist · Public sink: score_spend, get_api_key, set_wallet_allowlist · Destructive: set_wallet_allowlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: score_spend · Private data: score_spend, get_api_key, set_wallet_allowlist · Public sink: score_spend, get_api_key, set_wallet_allowlist · Destructive: set_wallet_allowlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
